capabilities: fix spelling and grammar errors in selected text
run correction from the command palette or editor context menu
choose the Mistral AI model in settings
customize the system prompt and switch UI language (Russian/English)
validate the API key in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a Russian-language version of the README is available. Installation is manual only (no community plugin store instructions).
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck only flags words and cannot correct spelling and grammar mistakes in selected text.

relations.evidence: checks and corrects spelling in text using Mistral AI

summary: Spell checker that fixes spelling and grammar errors in selected text via Mistral AI, with a configurable model and system prompt.
